hypothesis.statement: Periods of high realized volatility carry poor risk-adjusted forward returns for BTC. Staying long only when RV21 is NOT in the top tercile of its trailing 252-day distribution earns a structurally positive, parameter-robust risk-adjusted premium over buy-and-hold.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive forward return during active (non-high-vol) regime vs. flat during high-vol regime
hypothesis.mechanism_detail: High realized volatility marks stressed regimes: forced deleveraging, adverse selection, and uncertainty premiums suppress forward risk-adjusted returns. Avoiding these periods by going to flat harvests the asymmetry between normal and stressed return distributions. This is the BTC analogue of the equity volatility-managed portfolio premium (Moreira & Muir 2017). The effect operates through risk capacity, not alpha: BTC expected returns are not necessarily lower in high-vol, but the Sharpe is reliably worse due to non-linear drawdown dynamics.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: 7-day forward BTC returns are identically distributed in high-vol and non-high-vol regimes; vol-managed exposure adds no risk-adjusted edge over buy-and-hold.
hypothesis.role_note: Primary value as a conditioning variable and ML feature. Standalone Sharpe at 15bps is 0.130 (weak), but IS/OOS structure and sensitivity robustness make it a high-confidence conditioning input.

function_spec.name: H5 Volatility Regimes
function_spec.data_source: Binance BTCUSDT spot close (1m OHLCV resampled to daily close)
function_spec.decision_function_note: The decision function is decision_function_h5.py::compute_signal(). It embeds the full RV21 computation inline. Do NOT use sig_h5_vol_regimes from signals.py — that function reads a pre-computed m['vol_regime'] column and hashing it would not cover the RV algorithm.
function_spec.entry_condition: vol_regime in {low, medium} — i.e., RV21 NOT in top tercile of trailing 252d distribution
function_spec.exit_condition: vol_regime transitions to 'high' OR hold_days elapsed (7 calendar days); evaluated daily
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry + 7 calendar days; if vol_regime enters 'high' mid-hold, close at next daily evaluation (end-of-day close)

regime_definitions.signal_active: vol_regime in {low, medium} — the bottom two terciles

function_spec.sensitivity_attribution_note: The IS battery evaluated the equivalent signal under the name 'Volatility Regime' (GROUP1, signals.py::sig_volatility_regime) with parameterized variants. That function is mathematically identical to decision_function_h5.py::compute_signal(): same RV21 formula, same rolling-tercile logic, same position rule. Battery parameter convention uses pctile=33 (lower bound); this file uses HIGH_PCTILE=67 (upper bound) — these are the same threshold (33rd and 67th percentile of the same distribution). The h5 SEED entry in the battery had sens_results=[] because the seed calls sig_h5_vol_regimes (column reader, no parameters); all sensitivity results come from the Volatility Regime G1 entry. Sensitivity variants v3 and v4 here differ from G1 variants: G1 tested {pctile:25} and {pctile:40}; in HIGH_PCTILE convention these are HIGH_PCTILE=75 and HIGH_PCTILE=60 respectively.
function_spec.lockbox_status: none — no lockbox was held for this signal

evidence_basis.dsr_prob_note: IS only, n_trials=34 (frozen), cost_bps=15, hold_days=1. Fails Validated gate — expected; gate evaluated on forward returns.
evidence_basis.bh_p_note: IS only. 1 - PSR(forward=0). BH rank 15/34; reject=False at q=0.10.
evidence_basis.candidate_gate_result: PASS Feature gate — OOS Sharpe +0.678 > 0, Sensitivity 100%
notable_flags: IS/OOS sign disagreement: IS=-0.061 (negative), OOS=+0.678 (positive). Effect visible only in OOS window.
LOO consistency 67% exactly at threshold — structurally fragile to sub-period exclusion.
Sharpe CV=2.454 across LOO folds (high instability); 2 of 6 LOO folds negative.
STRUCTURAL POSITIVE: clean_sharpe (0.527) >> full_sharpe (0.130). Effect is STRONGER excluding event windows, confirming the signal is not driven by opportunistic structural-event capture.
Bear regime Sharpe -1.044: signal correctly avoids bear markets (long-flat), but when market is in bear and vol is low/medium, performance is poor.

observation_floors.rationale: n_trades_IS=30 over 5 IS years implies ~6 trade entries (7-day long-hold starts) per year. At 6/year, the 30-trade floor requires approximately 5 years (60 months) of forward collection. This is the single most important operational constraint for this signal — do not attempt promotion before 60 months unless n=30 is reached earlier. High-vol periods floor (5) required to confirm the exclusion decision has discriminating power. Both bull and bear market regimes must be observed for a balanced feature assessment. The 60-month floor supersedes the 18-month figure in any prior draft — that figure incorrectly estimated 15-25 regime entries per year, confusing regime transitions with the engine's 7-day-hold entry counting.

promotion_criteria.description: Criteria to advance h5_vol_regime from Candidate to Validated (Feature role). All gates must pass simultaneously. Evaluated only after observation_floors are met.

G1_direction.description: Mean 7-day forward return during active regime (vol not high) > 0 net of 15bps

G2_regime_differential.description: Sharpe during active-regime periods exceeds buy-and-hold Sharpe over the same calendar window

G3_high_vol_exclusion_value.description: Sharpe with high-vol periods excluded > Sharpe with no filtering (validates that the filter adds value)

G5_regime_coverage.description: At least 5 distinct transitions to high-vol state observed (confirms discriminating power of the regime)

promotion_criteria.dsr_bh_requirement: dsr_prob >= 0.50 AND bh_p <= 0.10 on forward trade returns at Validated gate (thresholds.yaml validated.feature)
promotion_criteria.provenance_requirement: pinned_run provenance must be live-forward or mainnet
notes: Feature role: G2 (regime differential) is the primary validation gate. G1 failing while G2 passes is 'signal is weak standalone but adds conditioning value'.
Failure at G1 AND G2 is 'effect absent in live data' — record as negative finding, do not promote.
Do not conclude negative before 60 months. IS/OOS disagreement warns that the effect is regime-sensitive and the IS period may not be representative.
LOO fragility: if forward evidence from a specific regime (e.g., sustained bear) causes the signal to fail, document the conditioning regime, do not disqualify globally.

PAIRWISE INDEPENDENCE: max_pairwise_r < 0.70 with all concurrently-Validated families is required at the Validated gate per thresholds.yaml validated.feature. Enforcement is deferred to the Proposal 1 implementation (see CLAUDE.md §16), but the requirement is binding. h5 is expected to be correlated with h6 at r >= 0.70 in similar vol environments — compute and record pairwise r before any Validated promotion attempt.

daily_job.trigger: once per day after daily close available (00:05 UTC)
data_inputs: Binance BTCUSDT spot close (last bar of day from 1m OHLCV)
steps: 1. Load last MIN_HISTORY (273) rows of spot close from corpus
3. Compute RV21 = annualized std of log-returns over last 21d: rolling(21).std() * sqrt(365)
5. Determine vol_regime: 'high' if RV21 > threshold, else 'active'
6. Log vol_regime and RV21 to regime_states with fn_hash (fn_hash = SHA-256 of decision_function_h5.py)
7. If vol_regime=='active' AND not in_hold: open trade_entries row (hold=7d)
8. If open trade and today == planned_exit OR vol_regime=='high': close trade_exits
9. Fill forward labels for 1d, 3d, 7d horizons on elapsed trades
11. Write run_log row with fn_hash + day_features_hash

evidence_snapshots.trigger: monthly (first calendar day of each month)
content: Running Sharpe on all completed 7-day holds
Vol regime distribution (fraction of days in high/medium/low)
Regime entry count (high-to-active transitions) vs minimum floor
DSR on non-overlapping 7-day return blocks (compute when n >= 15)
Power analysis: current n vs 30-trade floor; estimated months to floor at current entry rate
Regime differential check: Sharpe active vs buy-hold

determinism_check.mechanism: fn_hash in run_log must match decision_function_hash every run
determinism_check.alert: fn_hash mismatch: abort run, alert operator, do NOT write to signal_log

source_divergence_assessment.conclusion: Single-source signal — no divergence risk. RV21 from spot close is exchange-agnostic at <0.1% cross-exchange price spread.
source_divergence_assessment.cross_exchange_agreement: >99% (spot close insensitive to cross-exchange spread for 21-day RV)

known_risks.risk: IS/OOS sign reversal: IS Sharpe is negative (-0.061) while OOS is positive (+0.678). Forward data may confirm the IS period is the anomaly, OR reveal the OOS window was the lucky one.
known_risks.monitoring: Track forward Sharpe quarterly. If negative at 12 months, escalate to governance review before the 60-month assessment gate.

known_risks.risk: LOO instability: Sharpe CV=2.454 across LOO folds. Two LOO folds negative. Forward performance in a bear or sideways year may turn negative.
known_risks.monitoring: Stratify forward Sharpe by BTC market regime in monthly snapshots. Separate bull/bear/sideways performance.

known_risks.risk: Pairwise independence: h5 is a direct component of h6 (h6 requires vol_regime==medium). Forward pairwise r with h6 is likely >= 0.70 for similar vol environments. Independence check will block simultaneous Validated promotion of both.
known_risks.monitoring: Compute pairwise r with h6 at 12-month forward collection mark. Document if r >= 0.70 — this is expected and not a defect, but blocks simultaneous promotion of both. See also promotion_criteria.notes on Proposal 1 binding requirement.

known_risks.risk: Regime permanently active: if BTC enters sustained low-vol, vol_regime stays in {low, medium} for months, generating positions but limiting the signal's discriminating power.
known_risks.monitoring: Flag in monthly snapshot if high_vol_entries == 0 for any 90-day window.

known_risks.risk: Bear-regime performance: regime_sharpe bear = -1.044. If BTC enters a sustained bear market while vol_regime is spuriously in 'active' (low vol bear), the signal will generate losses.
known_risks.monitoring: Track SMA200-based market regime alongside vol_regime. A low-vol bear market is a failure mode for this signal and should be flagged in context of any negative period.

lockbox_status.notes: No lockbox was held for h5_vol_regime. This signal was evaluated in-sample over the full 2021-2026 corpus; the IS window is the training set. Forward evidence begins from the registration date with no held-out window.

notes: Do not modify decision_function_h5.py or the RV21/252d construction after registration. Parameter changes require VERSION bump and new registration.
The IS/OOS disagreement is the most important structural flag. Registration does not override this risk; it locks in the testable hypothesis that the OOS direction is the true signal.
LOO consistency 67% is exactly at the Candidate gate threshold — a one-fold failure would have failed candidacy. Forward evidence should be monitored especially closely against this fragility.
STRUCTURAL NOTE: clean_sharpe (0.527) > full_sharpe (0.130). The effect is STRONGER excluding structural event windows. This is a positive research integrity signal: the effect is not event-driven.
